name: Albania

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (single entry) via e-visa.al
fees.applies: nationalities not listed in the reciprocity schedule (default 'other countries' rate)
fees.notes: All Albanian visas are applied for online at e-visa.al; there is no separate e-visa vs sticker fee. Fees are set per nationality by Council of Ministers Decision (VKM) No. 329, dated 29.05.2024 - schedule ranges from gratis (e.g. Algeria, Palestine, China) to EUR 100 (e.g. Belarus, Kazakhstan). EUR 35 is the fallback rate where no reciprocity fee is set. Minors aged 6-12 pay half the adult fee.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (two entries)
fees.notes: Two-entry and multiple-entry fees vary widely by nationality (e.g. Nigeria: EUR 25 single / EUR 40 two-entry / EUR 80 multiple). No single amount applies; see reciprocity_variations and the official VKM 329/2024 schedule.

fees.name: Type A airport transit visa
fees.notes: The VKM 329/2024 schedule lists Type A airport-transit fees per nationality alongside Type C; default EUR 35 where no reciprocity rate exists. Applied via e-visa.al.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa for business purposes
fees.notes: Albania has no separate business-visa fee; business travel uses the Type C visa at the same nationality-based tariff as tourism.

reciprocity_variations.note: Type C single/two/multiple entry all EUR 15 (apply at Beijing, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul missions via e-visa).
China: short-stay Type C not listed (visa-free for short stays); Type D long-stay visa is gratis.
Single entry EUR 25; two entries EUR 40; multiple entries EUR 80.
Single entry EUR 20; two/multiple entries EUR 35.
Single, two and multiple entries all EUR 30.
Single entry EUR 25; two entries EUR 40; multiple entries EUR 80.
Single entry EUR 30; two/multiple entries EUR 50. (Russians are visa-free during the summer season under Albania's seasonal exemption when in force.)
US, UK and Canadian citizens do not require a visa for short stays (not in the visa-required schedule); US citizens may stay up to one year.

free_visa_notes: Most Western, EU, Gulf-resident and many other nationalities enter Albania visa-free for 90 days (US citizens up to 1 year). Holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen visas (previously used), or valid US/UK/EU residence permits, enter visa-free. Some visa-required nationalities pay no fee: Algeria and Palestine are gratis for all visa types; China's Type D is gratis. Saudi and Qatari citizens are visa-free for tourism 15 Apr-31 Dec 2026. Albania is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply.
